description: This Java class is a supplier for configuration objects based on the environment in which the service runs. It determines different hosting environments (CLOUD, DOCKER, FILE_BASED, DEVELOPMENT) and loads corresponding configuration resources or defaults, integrating environment-specific settings with Typesafe Config.

classes.name: ServiceSpecificEnvironmentConfigSupplier
classes.description: A final class implementing Supplier<Config> to provide environment-specific Config objects based on host environment.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method returning an instance of ServiceSpecificEnvironmentConfigSupplier for a given service name, using system environment variables to determine hosting environment.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the Config object tailored for the detected hosting environment.
